_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Hazard Assessment Test Report
summary: Describes the contents of a hazard assessment test report used to evaluate the safety and insensitive munitions characteristics of non-nuclear ordnance.
description_purpose: This item describes the contents of a hazard assessment test report. The test report is used to evaluate the safety and insensitive munitions characteristics of non-nuclear ordnance.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated by the "Hazard assessment test report" paragraph of MIL-STD-2105.

The following DID is used in conjunction with this DID and applies only if listed on the DD Form 1423 incorporated into the contract:
DI-T-30714  Master Test Plan/Program Test Plan
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The test report shall be formatted in accordance with MIL-STD-831 or the contractor's style as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following:

children.title: The name (type) of the test(s) covered by the report
Rationale for any deviations from the test plan
Safety and vulnerability-related conclusions drawn from the test results

preparation_instructions.title: Test results
preparation_instructions.content: The test results shall be described using the terms and definitions as specified in MIL-STD-2105.
